text.p: Top 10 films showing at Dutch cinemas (pvs week in brackets)
1 (1) RANSOM - Mel Gibson turns tables on his son's kidnappers
in emotional drama.
2 (2) THE FIRST WIVES CLUB - Comedy with Goldie Hawn, Bette
Midler and Diane Keaton seeking revenge on ex-husbands.
3 (3) EVITA - Madonna as Argentina's Eva Peron.
4 (-) DRAGON HEART - Adventure film set in middle-ages with
Sean Connery as voice of the dragon.
5 (-) THE GLIMMER MAN - Steven Segal as police officer hunting
psychopathic serial-killer.
6 (4) HUNCHBACK OF NOTRE DAME - Latest Disney animation.
7 (-) EXTREME MEASURES - Actor Hugh Grant uncovers diabolical
scheme of mad doctor Gene Hackman in hospital horror.
8 (5) DAYLIGHT - Stallone to the rescue in disaster-style film.
9 (-) PORTRAIT OF A LADY - Romance and intrigue in period piece
from award-winning director Jane Campion.
10 (7) MATILDA - Roal Dahl comedy starring Danny DeVito and
Rhea Perlman.
Source: Nederlandse Federatie voor Cinematografie.
Following is a selection of films PREMIERING this week:
STAR TREK: FIRST CONTACT - A trekky's delight as Captain
Jean-Luc Picard and the rest of the Enterprise crew travel back
in time to save the earth from being colonised by the unfriendly
Borg.
BOUND - A film-noir thriller involving lesbians, money
laundering and the Mob.
SHINE - Biography of neurotic Australian piano virtuoso David
Helgott who ended up as a circus attraction. Stars Sir John
Gielguld.
